shortDescription: Manage private automation hub execution environment images

options.name: ah_host
options.description: URL to Ansible Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_HOST), or E(AAP_HOSTNAME). If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used.

options.name: ah_password
options.description: Password for your Ansible Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_PASSWORD), or E(AAP_PASSWORD).

options.name: ah_path_prefix
options.description: API path used to access the api. For galaxy_ng this is either V(automation-hub) or the custom prefix used on install with E(GALAXY_API_PATH_PREFIX). For Automation Hub this is V(galaxy).

options.name: ah_token
options.description: The Ansible Automation Hub API token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (for example, bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the ah_token module. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_API_TOKEN), or E(AAP_TOKEN).

options.name: ah_username
options.description: Username for your Ansible Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_USERNAME), or E(AAP_USERNAME).

options.name: append
options.description: If V(yes), then add the tags specified in O(tags) to the image. If V(no), then sets the image tags to the given list and removes all the other existing tags.

options.name: name
options.description: Name and tag of the image to remove or modify. Use a colon character between the image name and the tag.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the Automation Hub host. Defaults to 10 seconds, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: state
options.description: If V(absent), then deletes the image and all its tags. If V(present), then updates the image tags.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of the image tags to update. Only used when O(state=present), otherwise ignored.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to Automation Hub Server. If V(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_VERIFY_SSL), or E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS).
